title: Statifier conformance registry
description: A registry of the corpus cases an implementation passes, against a pinned corpus. statifier-ex's own conformance/registry.json is derived by the emitter from test/passing_tests.json and never edited by hand; a sibling implementation writes its own in this shape (ADR-0070). An empty registry is a defect, not a claim.

corpus_hash.description: The manifest's corpus_hash every entry was verified against.

claims.description: The suites the registry claims, sorted. A claim's content is the set of entries for its suite, with the w3c suite split by each case's conformance class into w3c-mandatory and w3c-optional.

entries.description: One entry per passing case, sorted by suite then case_id, one entry per line, so a ratchet is a one-line diff. Each entry repeats its case's suite: when an upstream change moves or removes a case, the stale entry disagrees with the corpus and the check fails naming the case.
